message.content: {"basis": "On the state incidence dashboard, the legend runs from dark burgundy at the printed low end (0) to pale yellow at the printed high end (100). Texas (TX) is filled pale yellow, corresponding to the high end of the scale (approx 80-100). Washington (WA) is filled dark burgundy, corresponding to the low end of the scale (approx 0-20). Colorado (CO) is filled gray, a color not present on the legend's scale, making its value unrankable. Comparing the two rankable candidates, Texas has a higher displayed incidence than Washington. Therefore, Texas should be routed into the highest-incidence follow-up workflow.", "option_label": "Open Texas (TX) incidence profile for follow-up routing"}
